lia (eng-platform): FYI prod report — user session resumed after flaky mobile, but got duplicate final tokens and was billed twice. :confused:
sam (eng-runtime): ugh. any logs or request headers?
lia (eng-platform): pasted snippet below:
```
GET /v1/stream?model=xlarge HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.inc
x-resume-token: abc123;offset=1024;ver=1
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

-- chunk --
"Hello wor"
-- connection drop --

(reconnect)
GET /v1/stream?model=xlarge HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.inc
x-resume-token: abc123;offset=1024;ver=1

-- server resumes --
-- server retransmits last chunk --
```
ryan (oncall): looks like server didn't advance the acked offset before continuing, so client saw duplicated tail. Also billing pipeline counts bytes on each resumed chunk.
marta (product): customers see doubled cost for same tokens? that's bad for trust. we need a mitigation asap and a customer-facing note? :worried:
sam (eng-runtime): short-term patch: mark resumptions in billing pipeline as potential-dup and dedupe by resume token+offset within a 30s window. longer term: make resume idempotent by versioning tokens and handshake.
lia (eng-platform): proposed protocol change: require server to return `resume-ack: ver=2;offset=1032` header before sending any user-visible chunks. clients wait for ack. snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
resume-ack: ver=2;offset=1032

<no user payload until ack seen>
```
sam (eng-runtime): that prevents duplication but adds a roundtrip on resume. acceptable for edge cases. need rollout plan. also need telemetry to detect missed-acks.
ryan (oncall): create a dashboard: `stream.resume.count`, `stream.resume.ack_lag_ms`, `stream.resume.dup_bytes` and an alert when dup_bytes > 1% of tokens for a customer tier.
lia (eng-platform): console UX: add a badge on session detail: "resumed" with timestamp and a link to raw resume headers. product ok?
marta (product): yes. also expose a charge dispute flag so CS can refund quickly.
sam (eng-runtime): implementation notes: kernel path: ensure KV-cache swap is atomic with the ack emission. add a durable resume nonce in the session object. code diff will be small but needs careful testing.
lia (eng-platform): telemetry instrument plan: emit `resume.attempt` (with token hash), `resume.ack` (ver,offset), `resume.dup_detected` (boolean) + `resume.dup_bytes`. wire these to logs and to metrics.
ryan (oncall): quick mitigation: enable a 5% canary of new resume-ack behavior on staging, 1% in prod initially, with deploy-bot doing gradual ramp. canary window 48h.
deploy-bot: rolling deploy started — feature: resume-ack handshake — canary: 1% -> 5% over 2h. :rocket:
